subject: Procurement path check-in — PO vs marketplace and SOC 2 asks
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Emily Jones <emily.jones@lumenhealth.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 15 Jan 2026 15:12:00 -0800
Subject: Procurement path check-in — PO vs marketplace and SOC 2 asks

Emily — thanks again for a productive call earlier. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we keep momentum: 

Summary of what we heard
- Lumen wants to move quickly on a 6–8 week pilot for NLU on patient messaging.
- Preferred payment route is through your PO process, but procurement also mentioned marketplace purchases could speed procurement if available.
- SOC 2 Type II evidence and a signed DPA are gating items for legal/procurement before a PO is issued.
- You may also need a completed security questionnaire from our side — sounds like the GC/infra team will review that.

Proposed immediate path
1) Fast pilot: enable a short marketplace trial (if procurement confirms marketplace SKU is acceptable) to unblock the pilot while we run PO negotiation in parallel.
2) We’ll send our SOC 2 summary + the DPA for review today.
3) Redwood to pre-fill the security questionnaire (we have a template already) and return within 3 business days.

Immediate asks from you
- Can procurement confirm whether marketplace purchases are allowed for a pilot (even if final purchase goes via PO)?
- Target PO approver and estimated PO lead time (ballpark).

Attachments: redwood-commercial-options-summary.pdf (summary of PO vs marketplace path and pricing), redwood-soc2-report-summary.pdf (top-line SOC 2 controls).

I’ll loop in Priyom to handle the questionnaire pre-fill and Marissa for any contract escalations.

Thanks — Ben
Ben Carter | Account Executive, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0143
Redwood Inference
From: Emily Jones <emily.jones@lumenhealth.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: LumenHealth Procurement <procurement@lumenhealth.com>
Date: Fri, 16 Jan 2026 09:24:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Procurement path check-in — PO vs marketplace and SOC 2 asks

Thanks Ben — great summary. A couple of clarifications from procurement/ops side: 

- Marketplace: procurement prefers PO for anything that exceeds our $10k sandbox threshold, but for a short pilot < $5k they will allow marketplace purchases if the vendor supports invoicing through our cloud marketplace account. We need your marketplace SKU and billing contact to confirm.
- PO timeline: once legal clears the DPA and we have SOC 2 evidence, PO issuance is typically 2–3 weeks. If legal needs to redline the DPA that can add time.
- Security questionnaire: yes — our ISO team will expect a completed questionnaire (we use the vendor-risk spreadsheet) and an AOC/SOC2 report or summary.

I’ve attached our procurement template and the vendor-risk checklist for your reference (Attachment: lumen-procurement-template.docx).

If you can get us the SOC 2 summary and a pre-filled questionnaire by next Tuesday (20th), we’ll prioritize legal review and aim for a PO by early February. Otherwise the marketplace pilot path is our fastest route to start work right away.

—Emily
Emily Jones | Sr. Manager, Vendor Operations, LumenHealth
emily.jones@lumenhealth.com | +1 (617) 555-0199
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 19 Jan 2026 10:02:00 -0800
Subject: Internal: recommended approach for Lumen pilot + paperwork

Ben/Marissa — quick internal note following Emily’s reply: 

Recommendation:
- Offer a two-track plan: 1) marketplace trial (low friction) to start within 48–72 hours once Emily confirms SKU availability; 2) parallel PO negotiation with target PO in ~2–3 weeks after DPA/SOC2 evidence. This keeps momentum and reduces risk of losing exec interest.

Checklist of things we should return to Lumen by Tue 20 Jan:
- SOC 2 summary + AOC stub (redwood-soc2-report-summary.pdf) — I’ll attach our one-page controls map.
- Pre-filled vendor-risk spreadsheet (I’ll populate answers for network/ops controls and escalate any items that need engineering input).
- Draft DPA via DocuSign link (we should use our standard DPA, legal can quick review if they want redlines).

Operational notes:
- Marketplace SKU: I can pull the marketplace listing and billing contact; if Lumen approves, we can spin up pilot access under their marketplace account and issue trial credits.
- If procurement insists on PO-only for the pilot, we should push for a narrow SOW and capped spend to speed approval.

I’ll prepare the pre-filled questionnaire and attach the SOC2 summary — assigning myself to that.

—Priyom
Priyom Das | Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Emily Jones <emily.jones@lumenhealth.com>, LumenHealth Procurement <procurement@lumenhealth.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Jan 2026 10:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Procurement path check-in — PO vs marketplace and SOC 2 asks

Emily/Procurement team — following up with a concrete mutual action plan so everyone has dates: 

Mutual action plan (proposed)
- Jan 20: Redwood to deliver SOC2 one-pager, pre-filled vendor-risk spreadsheet, and DPA DocuSign link. (Attachments: redwood-soc2-report-summary.pdf; prefilled-vendor-risk.xlsx; DocuSign DPA link).
- Jan 21–22: Lumen legal/procurement review DPA & SOC2 materials.
- Jan 23: If marketplace purchase is approved by procurement, Redwood will provision pilot access and issue trial keys. If marketplace is not approved, Redwood and Lumen will proceed with PO route and target PO issuance by ~Feb 6 (subject to legal redlines).

Links: DocuSign DPA: https://www.docusign.com/some/dpa-sign-link/abcdef
Drive: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1a2b3c_redwood-playbook

Ben — Priyom has the questionnaire pre-filled and the SOC2 summary attached; Marissa will monitor legal redlines. Emily, if this timeline works for you I’ll send the DocuSign invite now.

Thanks — Ben
